versions.changelog:
- Initial release of HDHive search skill.
- Generates direct HDHive search URLs based on user keywords (with auto-encoding).
- Locates and directs users to TMDB-based detail pages for movies and TV shows.
- No longer extracts specific download links; resource detail pages are provided instead.
- Informs users about limitations and extra steps needed for 115CDN and OpenClaw direct links.
